capture_capture_cancellation_requested_t: Cancellation requested. No new capture result will be published by this operation. Recorder exit and owned-file cleanup still require verification.
capture_completed_stop_requested: Recording stopped on request; capture output saved.
capture_confirm_displayed_target_and_sta: Confirm displayed target and start capture
capture_confirming_creates_a_private_loc: Confirm creates private local/remote sessions and records this process (64 MiB transfer limit; plan expires in 60 seconds). Stop and save finishes recording and saves output only after verified exit. Cancel aborts without publishing a new result. Manual recording has a 24-hour host safety limit. Disconnects or unverified termination report the retained directory. Requires Simpleperf stdin profiling controls; no permission changes. Unix conversion uses a bounded output pipe.
capture_duration_limit: Timed duration: positive finite seconds up to 300, including fractions. Blank selects manual stop (24-hour host safety limit).
capture_duration_manual: Duration: manual stop (24-hour host safety limit)
capture_invalid_duration: Enter positive finite seconds up to 300, including fractions, or leave blank for manual stop. The entered value has not been changed.
capture_invalid_event: Enter a Simpleperf event token of at most 256 ASCII characters, starting with a letter or digit. Only letters, digits, _, :, -, . and / are allowed.
capture_invalid_frequency: Enter a whole frequency from 1 to 4000 Hz. The entered value has not been changed.
capture_invalid_period: Enter an event count from 1 to 9223372036854775807 per sample. The entered value has not been changed.
capture_invalid_target: Select a device and process, or enter a valid ADB serial and positive 32-bit PID.
capture_inspect_is_read_only_only_the_ex: Inspect is read-only. Only the explicit confirmation below starts device recording.
capture_state_stop_unverified: Stop unverified; no capture result published
capture_owned_remote_files_cleaned: Recorder exit verified; owned remote files cleaned.
